purpose: Normalize actual acquisition spend/fees into evidence records without guessing or treating missing integrations as zero cost.

accepted_source_classes.note: Manual entry is evidence-backed fallback, not estimated spend.

zero_spend_rule: spend=0 is VERIFIED only when coverage evidence proves the source covers the requested paid platform/account/time window. Missing connector or missing imported cost is UNKNOWN, not zero.
currency_rule: Cross-currency Marketing Net Profit requires an evidenced FX rate/timestamp; otherwise keep per-currency results separate.
privacy_rule: No customer PII, card/payment credentials or ad-account secrets in normalized records.
current_missing: Google Ads direct cost connector or proven GA4 cost-import coverage
Meta Ads cost connector when/if used
TikTok Ads cost connector when/if used
other paid-channel cost source when/if used
hard_rules: Never estimate spend from clicks, sessions, revenue or ROAS.
Never convert missing cost data into zero.
Never accept UNVERIFIED or PARTIAL records as CAC/Marketing Net Profit truth.
Never write campaign budgets or change external ads.
All external write actions remain Owner-gated elsewhere.
